tei:div.tei:p: gegs sel rten 'brel sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

gegs sel rten 'brel sgo 'byed ni/ /gegs dang 'gal rkyen nam byung yang*/ /'don thabs gsum las med pas te/ /lta ba rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis 'don pa/ sgom pa gsal ba'i thabs kyis 'don pa/ spyod pa zab mo rten 'brel gyis 'don pas te/ spyi khrid rang na gsal lo/ / khyad par bka' rgyud gnad la dbab pa ni/ nad pa'am gegs pa'i drung du rten bkram/ mchod pa dang tshogs dang gtor ma bshams la/ a ma'i sku gcig /bla ma'i zhabs rjes/ gcod kyi sa'i cha nad pa'i spyi bo'am na sar bzhag la/ der bka' brgyud bla ma spyan drangs la/ na mo sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun/ bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro/ chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma byin rlabs can phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dren pa'i bla ma thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da res yod na da res yod/ da res med na da res med/ da res thugs rje dang byin rlabs skyed cig /dkon mchog gsum bden nam mi bden/ bla ma bka' rgyud rnams/ gdams pa bdud kyi gcod yul/ rgyu 'bras dge sdig mos gus byin rlabs rnams bden nam mi bden da res blta'o/ /dad pa can yid thang ma bcad/ mos gus can blo ldog tu ma gzhug /nyams len byed pa rnams chos la blo ldog tu ma gzhug /rgyu 'bras spyod pa rnams rgyu 'bras la the tshom zar ma gzhug /rgyu 'bras las ngan dang sgrib pa/ rkyen gdon bgegs dang 'byung po/ 'bras bu na tsha dang sdug bsngal thams cad/ dus da lta nyid du/ sa 'di nyid du/ thabs 'di la brten nas sos par byin rlobs shig /yum a ma jo mo yi dam khros ma nag mo/ bka' pha rol du phyin pa/ gdams pa bdud kyi gcod yul/ byin rlabs yod dam med/ thugs rje che chung*/ phan mi phan/ bden nam mi bden da res blta'o/ /byin rlabs gnad 'bebs zab mo'i gdams pa'o/ / ༈ bogs 'don yon tan sgo 'byed kyang*/

/yar bla ma dkon mchog la mos gus la brten nas bogs 'don pa/ mar sems can la snying rje la brten nas bogs 'don pa/ bar bar gcod la thog rdzis la brten nas bogs 'don pa ste yon tan gyi bogs 'don pa gsum gyis bogs 'don par bya'o/ /spyi khrid na gsal lo/ /de nyid log na bkol yang 'di las zab pa bshad rgyu med/ rdzogs so// // kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams lugs kyi gcod yul 'di/ rig 'dzin gter ston gyi rgyal po padma gling pa nas brgyud pa'o/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi bka' 'bum/ (26)gegs sel rten 'brel sgo 'byed/ - PAGE 38 -- PAGE 53 -- PAGE 52 -
